Hi all — I put together the provisional calc and attached the spreadsheet and timeline PDF for your records (zenara_credit_calc.xlsx; incident-timeline-zenara.pdf). Summary below.

Assumptions and data points used:
- Contracted monthly commitment: $45,000
- Measurement window: July 2027 (31 days = 744 hours)
- Outage window (per incident timeline): 2027-07-18T02:12Z - 2027-07-18T05:40Z = 3.47 hours
- Uptime for July = (744 - 3.47)/744 = 99.532%
- SLA tiers (per contract ZENA-ENT-2026-045):
  - >= 99.9% => no credit
  - >= 99.0% and < 99.9% => 5% of monthly commitment
  - < 99.0% => 10% of monthly commitment

Result: 99.532% falls into the >=99.0% and <99.9% bucket => eligible for 5% credit.

Credit amount = $45,000 * 5% = $2,250.

Notes and caveats:
- We excluded the short maintenance event at 2027-07-03 which is already covered by scheduled maintenance clauses.
- The final credit will be subject to a one-time validation by Finance and a remedy agreement signature (DocuSign link to follow).

Recommended routing:
1) Finance review & sign-off (Marissa cc) — internal SLA credit memo creation (2 business days)
2) Customer signature on remedy agreement (DocuSign) — if Zenara prefers invoice credit, we apply to next invoice; if payout, finance issues refund (timing differs by payment method).

I've attached the calc and the timeline. Evan — if you confirm invoice credit, I'll open the finance ticket and queue the memo.

Thanks,
